items.say: Zip the robot hid a gem inside the boot. A crow was watching, so he moved it behind the shield. A mouse came sniffing around, so he moved it one more time, under the flag. Where is the gem now?

Sir Clank the knight hid a coin under the flag. A mouse came sniffing around, so he moved it behind the book. He thought about putting it under the map, but he did not. In the end, he put it back where it was at the start. Where is the coin now?
Zip the robot put a key behind the book and an egg inside the chest. Later, he moved the key under the crown. Then he moved the egg to the place where the key was at the start. Where is the key now?
Zazz the wizard found a star and gave it to Dash the fox. Dash did not need it, so she passed it on to Pounce the cat. Pounce kept it safe. Who has the star now?

Hoot the owl hid a star behind the book. The wind began to blow, so she moved it under the map. A crow was watching, so she moved it one more time, under the flag. Where did Hoot hide the star at the very start?

Hoot the owl hid a ring under the bell. A crow was watching, so she moved it under the flag. She thought about putting it behind the drum, but she did not. In the end, she left it right where it was. Where is the ring now?
Zip the robot put a star under the map and an egg behind the drum. Later, he moved the star under the bell. Then he moved the egg to the place where the star was at the start. Where is the star now?
Boo the ghost found a potion and gave it to Zazz the wizard. Zazz did not need it, so he passed it on to Pounce the cat. Pounce took it back to the one who found it. Who has the potion now?

Sir Clank the knight hid a ring under the map. That did not feel safe enough, so he moved it behind the shield. Somebody walked by, so he moved it one more time, inside the rocket. Where was the ring before the very last move?

Boo the ghost hid a gem under the bell. That did not feel safe enough, so he moved it inside the boot. He thought about putting it inside the rocket, but he did not. In the end, he put it back where it was at the start. Where is the gem now?
